rv.q: If your little ones are likely to enjoy playful elves, sassy polar bears and bright lights, it will keep them entertained.
Beautifully choreographed, musically engaging and genuinely heartwarming, this festive production reminds us that those who spend their lives caring for others deserve to be cared for, too.

cn.t: Critics are split on *Santa's First Christmas* — one calls it a five-star festive triumph, while another is less convinced. Strong production values earn praise, but the show doesn't win over all reviewers equally.
